part: Carbon variant of the first model: 1.5 mm wall, same inside; the bent ear is replaced by a solid 5 mm lug on the same screw. Moulded with plain plates: the slashes are cut afterwards.
layout: top piece (back, lug, top and bottom faces, tip end) / middle mould (inside) / bottom piece (front, tabs)

charge_g.note: 50 % fibre by volume, 20 % extra for flash

hardware: 4 x M6 bolts 90 mm long (or threaded rod) with washers and nuts, 2 x 6 mm dowel pins
demould_order: slide the cap off the middle mould along the lamp axis, towards the tip

checks.check: Fit: Cap vs lamp head, overlap volume
Fit: Cap vs stalk, socket and screw boss, overlap volume
Fit: Liner gap, top / bottom plate
Fit: Liner gap, back wall
Fit: Liner gap, tip wall
Fit: Keeper tabs to lens chamfer (closest point)
Fit: Tab hook depth past the head's top edge
Fit: Slides on from the tip without touching (8 stations)
Fit: Top/bottom symmetric (same part for left and right)
Fit: Cap stays behind the lens front face
Fit: Lens light window obstructed
Fit: Wall thickness for forged carbon
Fit: Inside bend radius (carbon needs a radius)
Fit: Lug wall around the slot (end / sides / to back wall)
Fit: Lug thickness under the screw head
Fit: Exposed corner radius
Cavity contains all of the finished carbon part
Extra material: the slashes (cut after moulding)
Extra material: corner fills at the back-tip corner
middle is one valid solid
top is one valid solid
bottom is one valid solid
No two pieces overlap (part, middle, top, bottom)
Pieces and part fill the block exactly (no voids)
Demould 1: bottom piece comes off forwards (-y)
Demould 2: top piece comes off backwards (+y)
Demould 3: cap slides off the middle mould along the lamp (+x)
